mods.name: Madita
mods.author: tebogebo
mods.description:
Makes Monita very mad.

Install on Cemu
Download the cemu mod file, open cemu, hit file > open cemu folder.
Unzip the mod folder into it (drag graphicpacks to cemu folder)
Go to Options > Graphic Packs and you should see it under Nintendo Land > Mods > Madita (you might have to re-open Cemu for it to show up) and turn it on

Install on Wii U (not working currently)
Install Aroma custom firmware and get the sdcafiine plugin from the HB App Store.
Download the wii u mod file and extract the wiiu folder from the zip onto the root of your SD card. (There should already be a wiiu folder, you just need to merge them)
When you launch the game, the sdcafiine menu will show up asking you to select the modpack (it might just show up briefly to tell you it's booting this mod if you only have this mod installed).
mods.changelog: Fixes wii u not loading the mod at all. (Also ends up being 100 KB smaller of a file)

mods.description:
A simple mod in which Mario's outfit changes color to a blue shirt and red overalls based in his old design.

How to use:

In the SDCaffine Folder, create a folder with the game code based on your region.
JPN: 0005000010101F00
USA: 0005000010102000
EUR: 0005000010102100

And drop the content folder in it.

mods.name: Project Crystal (A Nintendo Land Modpack)
mods.author: TheN00b21
mods.description:
Hey, Remember Me? I'm that game that literally no one talks about! Well, I'm back, back with MODS!
WARNING: This Modpack is not nearly finished, but there is a download. It is quite low quality for now but if I can get a small team together this can become a huge modpack.

This is the first-ever modpack for Nintendo Land! Why is it called Project Crystal? Idk it just kinda sounded cool. I will try to revamp the entire game to a whole new state making it WAY better than the original. It will include brand new skins (yes, model imports too), entirely new stages or levels for some games, some new layouts (hopefully better), and if I'm smart enough, new game modes!!! This will be an extremely hard project because of the number of different games Nintendo Land has to offer. However, I will try my best to do it all. All screenshots are from the pack running on a real Wii U. (Sorry for the lack of pictures, I'll try to get more later)
So far this pack contains:

Plaza and Misc:

    Among us Imposter over Monika
    Many Star, Coin, etc. gradient recolors
    There is more but mostly meme stuff, relatively hidden

Battle Quest:

    DQ Slimes Replacing Red/Green Balloon Enemies
    Minecraft Diamond Sword for enemies
    Pot Lid over the wood shield and Mario star over the metal shield
    Kamek over parrot enemies
    Cool new costumes for Link (Archer and all swordsmen)


Metroid Blast:

    A few costume changes for enemies, and power-ups


Mario Chase:

    Luigi Circuit over course 1 (Incomplete)
    N64 Skyscraper over course 2 (Incomplete)
    Costume changes for Toads, Mario, and Yoshis


Luigi's Ghost Mansion:

    GCN Cookie Land test model import over the 5th course
    Costume changes for "Luigis" and Ghost
    Small flashlight changes 
    Battery logos changed

To download click one of the file sources and it will take you to a place you can download the modpack (The file is too big for Gamebanana so I had to host it somewhere else). Progress is slow to my busy schedule but I will try to work on if when I feel like it. I have many other mods that I am working on at all times.
mods.changelog:
New Plaza, Mario Chase, and other miscellaneous changes
First Stable Proof of Concept Download.
